activation.rule: A sample is valid only after PI accepts and merges this exact Gate-A package.

baseline_contract.candidate_order: frozen B0 score descending, portfolio_id ascending tie break
baseline_contract.source: externally supplied accepted outcome-unexposed B0 package for the target issue

decision_chain.aggregation: scan the exact frozen B0 candidate order and select the first fully covered identity without HIGH risk
decision_chain.confidence: consumer HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NOT_ACTIONABLE from active state, contradiction state, producer confidence and provenance eligibility
decision_chain.fact_extraction: strict schema: availability, role_class, severity, direction; immutable fact/raw IDs retained
decision_chain.handicap_translation: diagnostic direction only; probabilities and handicap line remain unchanged
decision_chain.risk_rule: HIGH rejects identities containing that match; MEDIUM annotates only; CLEAR keeps B0 order

evidence_contract.common_cutoff: one timezone-aware cutoff shared by the issue decision; strictly before every selected match kickoff
evidence_contract.consumer_api: MessageEvidenceLedger.export_as_of plus one coverage report per required kind

forward_horizon.primary_checkpoint: 20 matched message-eligible issues and at least 30 post-activation calendar issues

outcome_boundary: No score, result, final SP, winning SP, payout, tax, ROI or settlement data may enter Gate A or a decision freeze.

outcome_settlement.positive_claim: strict independent EV plus further forward evidence required
outcome_settlement.tax_rule: per winning CNY2 ticket; no issue/person aggregation

participation_accounting.coverage: report ledger coverage, abstention and each error reason separately from selection lift
participation_accounting.matched: restrict B0 and M1 to identical issue set; compare equal CNY4374 issue stakes
participation_accounting.native: report B0 on every valid baseline issue and message arms only when their policy selects
participation_accounting.no_bet: zero executed tickets and zero stake; never a losing bet

sample_selector.primary: first integer issue strictly greater than minimum_issue_exclusive with a content-addressed B0 package and cutoff-safe message exports created after activation
